tax_name: Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée (TVA) / الرسم على القيمة المضافة
legal_ref: Code des taxes sur le chiffre d'affaires (CTCA), art. 21 as amended by art. 26 of Finance Law (LF) 2017; reduced rate art. 23
quote: Art. 21 - La taxe sur la valeur ajoutée est perçue au taux normal de 19 %. [fn: modifié par les articles … 21/LF 2001 et 26/LF2017] … Art. 23 - Le taux réduit de la taxe sur la valeur ajoutée est fixé à 9 %. — VAT is levied at the normal rate of 19%; reduced rate 9%
source_title: Direction Générale des Impôts (Algeria) – Code des taxes sur le chiffre d'affaires, édition 2023 (FR) — Wayback Machine copy; mfdgi.gov.dz timed out / TLS error from here, CTCA 2025 edition (mfdgi.gov.dz/files/777/2025/2526/CTCA2025FR.pdf) not retrievable

reduced_rates.scope: listed agricultural products and inputs, certain foodstuffs, medicines-related items, social housing, tourism/hotel services, specified equipment and services (CTCA art. 23)

notes: Rates raised by LF 2017 from 17%/7% to 19%/9%. Exports and certain supplies exempt with right to deduction. TVA administered by the DGI under the CTCA; the Code des impôts indirects covers alcohol etc. separately. No sub-national VAT.
unverified: Text checked is the 2023 CTCA edition; the 2025/2026 editions could not be retrieved — rate believed unchanged but not confirmed in a 2026 text
valid_from assumes LF 2017 (Loi 16-14) applied from 1 January 2017; commencement clause not read
